submissions.tagline: The world's most-used AI assistant — chat, search, code, and create with GPT
submissions.description: ChatGPT is OpenAI's flagship conversational AI, the product that brought generative AI to over 200 million weekly active users. Powered by the GPT family of models, ChatGPT handles everything from quick answers and brainstorming to complex reasoning, code generation, agentic tasks, image generation via DALL·E, voice conversations, and live web browsing. submissions.tagline: Google's most capable AI — multimodal, agentic, and built into everything you already use
submissions.description: Gemini is Google's flagship AI assistant, powered by the Gemini model family (Ultra, Pro, Flash, and Nano) and built natively into Google Search, Workspace, Android, Chrome, and the Gemini app. Originally launched as Bard in early 2023, Gemini was relaunched with the Gemini 1.0 model in late 2023 and has since shipped 1.5 (massive 2M-token context), 2.0 (agentic), and 2.5 (deep think) generations.

submissions.tagline: Your everyday AI companion — built into Windows, Edge, and Microsoft 365
submissions.description: Microsoft Copilot is Microsoft's AI assistant brand, powered primarily by OpenAI's GPT models (with growing investment in Microsoft's own MAI-series). submissions.tagline: The answer engine — AI search with real-time citations you can verify
submissions.description: Perplexity is an AI-powered answer engine that combines real-time web search with large language models to return cited, source-linked answers instead of a list of blue links. Every Perplexity response includes the URLs it used, so you can verify and dig deeper.
